text:
ashley: Quick check-in  Optimize toolkit priorities: two runway items from customers — 1) eval-driven alerts for regressions, 2) lightweight mobile batching guidance. Suggest tight scope: deliver alert infra + PD hook (beta) and a batching-hints docs + client snippet. Keep quant recs for follow-up. Agree?

sam: I support narrow scope. Ask: should alerts cover perf (latency/cost) on day 1 or only model-quality regressions?

lee: Start with quality signals only (eval deltas, prompt concordance, label drift). Perf anomalies are higher-noise and should be added after we stabilize quality alerts.

lee: example alert template (for ops):
```
trigger if (avg_concordance_drop_pct > 4 AND sample_count >= 50) OR (eval_auc_drop > 0.06) over 24h
include: tenant_id, eval_pack_id, top_20 failing prompts, last_20 model outputs
```

gina: Customer asks: AcmeHealth needs PD integration + quiet hours config. Zephyr (mobile) asked for a tiny client helper: "shouldBatch(lastNFailures, networkState)" and default thresholds. They want a ready-to-use snippet they can drop in.

marta: From CS: Beta customers will want a runbook + escalation playbook. We should provide an ops contact and a rollback path.

kai: Infra needs: per-tenant eval buckets, a durable alert queue, and a canary flag for enabling alerts on a small set of tenants. Also need KV cache telemetry to show batching effectiveness. ETA: 3 weeks if we scope tightly.

sam: UI work: simple alert rule editor (choose template, tweak threshold), and a compact alert inbox in Console. I can mock two screens this week. API needed: /alerts/eval-diff?tenant=... returning recent diffs.

ashley: Proposed acceptance gates:
- Alerts firing on internal eval suite with documented hits/false-positive rate < 5% over 72h
- PD webhook + Console notification tested end-to-end
- Batching hints doc + JS + Kotlin snippets in repo
- Beta runbook + oncall owner assigned

ashley: Quick checklist (owners):
[ ] infra: alert queue + canary flag (kai)
[ ] ml: rule templates + eval packs (lee)
[ ] ui: editor + inbox mock (sam)
[ ] cs: beta runbook + customer ops contact (gina)
[ ] docs: batching snippets + mobile heuristic guide (marta)

gina: I'll coordinate AcmeHealth PD webhook details and ask Zephyr for a sample connectivity trace by Friday.

marta: I'll draft the batch helper snippet and include a minimal heuristic: batch when (queueLen >= 3 AND network==metered) OR (timeSinceLastSend > 200ms).

sam: Mockup note: keep alert editor to 2 fields for MVP (template + threshold), plus an "enable for tenant" toggle. No rule builder for launch.

lee: I'll build 3 starter templates: concordance_drop, eval_auc_drop, prompt_failure_rate. Will attach a small labeled eval pack for internal verification.

kai: I'll add dashboards for eval diffs and KV hit/miss rates and a toggle to enable alerts per-tenant. Will also expose an API for the UI to fetch recent diffs.

ashley: Rollout plan: internal-redwood -> 2 beta tenants (AcmeHealth, Zephyr) -> gradual ramp to early-adopter list. Target beta handoff in 5 weeks.

ashley: Risk callouts: quant recommendations creep, advanced cost-anomaly alerts, or building a full rule-builder. If any of those are proposed, we push to post-beta.

lee: On metrics, recommend we report: alert precision, mean time to triage, % of alerts with attached repro sample. Keep these visible in Console.

marta: For mobile snippets I'll add both JS and Android (Kotlin) examples and a tiny test harness for Zephyr to simulate poor connectivity.

gina: I'll build the customer onboarding checklist and include a PD escalation sample and suggested contact hours.

sam: Will create the UI prototype by Wed and share a link in this thread.

kai: ETA for infra pieces: canary flag + storage + dashboards = 3 weeks; PD webhook test harness = 1 week.

ashley: Owners confirmed: sam(UI), lee(templates), kai(infra), gina(customer ops), marta(docs/snippets). I'll track milestones and coordinate beta sign-off.

deploy-bot: Event scheduled: "Optimize toolkit - beta launch planning"  Calendar invite sent for 2025-03-19 09:00 PT. Attendees: ashley, sam, lee, gina, kai, marta.

ashley: Thanks all. Goal: ship quality-alerts + mobile batching guidance into beta in ~5 weeks. We'll meet tomorrow to finalize cut scope. :rocket:
